meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 它会先复现问题、对照 LazyCodex 与上游 Codex 源码判断归属仓库,再生成一份带复现步骤、证据、根因和修复建议的英文 GitHub issue 或 PR,并打上 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我报告一个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug
say.note: 会先复现定位,再生成 issue

say.text: 给这个 bug 写一份带根因和修复建议的 issue
say.note: 产出英文 issue 正文并提交

howto.what_en: It reproduces the bug, compares LazyCodex and upstream Codex sources to pick the owning repo, then files an English GitHub issue or PR with repro steps, evidence, root cause, fix guidance, and the lazycodex-generated label.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: Help me report a LazyCodex installer bug
This Codex CLI crash reproduces on clean upstream; file it on openai/codex
Write an issue with root cause and fix guidance for this bug
say_en.note: Produces and submits the English issue
